decision.reasoning_trace: Out of the 25 items provided, many were camping accessories (tents, pads, pillows) rather than traditional backpacks. I narrowed my consideration set down to the five most relevant backpack-style products: a hydration pack, a tactical pack, a high-end winter pack, a specialized disc golf bag, and a team-branded sports bag. I chose the Gelindo 18L Hiking Hydration Backpack (prod_backpacks_078) as the final purchase because it offers the highest rating (4.7) and best value for money at $31.49, with reviews confirming its utility for both outdoor activities and events.
